caption:
A woman saves a driver from thugs.
Seedance 2.5 landed every single kick here.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 20 seconds | 16:9 | photorealistic live-action Japanese street action cinema, 35-40mm lenses, natural overcast daylight with soft flat shadows, muted cool-gray grade with deep blacks and red rose accents | grounded camera at low height, smooth tracking, real-time full-contact combat with one brief slow-motion beat | pacing: tense 4-second build, three fast fight beats, then a quiet 5-second hold at the end.

CHARACTERS:
- THE HEROINE: woman about 25, pale skin, long straight ash-blonde hair worn loose past her shoulders with slightly darker roots, fine features, half-lidded bored eyes, faint smirk. Long black velvet duster coat to mid-calf, embroidered all over with red and pink roses and green leaves; low-cut black camisole top; layered thin silver necklaces; black skinny jeans; black lace-up suede ankle boots with block heels. The rose-embroidered coat swings and flares with every move.
- THE TAXI DRIVER: Japanese woman about 25, short copper-brown bob with bangs, white long-sleeve shirt, navy-blue vest, red striped tie, black trousers.
- THUG A: tall man about 30, dark curly hair, full dark beard, black leather jacket, black T-shirt, black jeans.
- THUG B: man about 30, short dark hair, beard, light-gray padded bomber jacket, black trousers.
- THUG C: lean man about 30, short brown hair, stubble, olive-green bomber jacket with orange lining, black T-shirt, gray jeans, black sneakers.
Exactly three thugs, always individually recognizable; no fourth attacker.

LOCATION: the taxi rank outside a large modern Japanese railway station by day. A long concrete canopy overhead on white cylindrical columns, the station's glass-and-steel facade behind, light-gray square paving with an orange line along the curb, a row of classic boxy Japanese sedan taxis (black ones and one white one) parked at the curb, a small red-and-white taxi stand sign on a pole, commuters in long coats walking and standing in the background.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:04.2) — The slap. Camera inside the back seat of a black taxi, looking out through its open rear door: blue-gray seat edge on the left, the door's red inner edge and window on the right, framing the street like a picture frame. Locked-off with a tiny drift. The heroine is stepping out of the taxi in the left foreground, seen from behind and the side, smoothing her rose coat, hair swinging. About 5 meters beyond her, Thug A grips the taxi driver's upper arm and yanks her toward him; Thugs B and C stand right behind him. At 00:02.0 Thug A slaps the driver once across the cheek: her head snaps sideways, her bob flies, she staggers one step but stays standing. At 00:03.0 the heroine turns her head over her shoulder toward them, her face going from bored to ice-cold.

SHOT 2 (00:04.2-00:07.3) — The interception. Exterior, medium-wide side view at chest height, the black taxi with its open rear door at the left edge, more taxis lined up behind; slow lateral tracking to the right. The heroine walks into the gap between the driver and Thug A; the driver steps back behind her to the left. Thug A turns and throws a hard right punch with full hip rotation; she slips outside it, traps his arm, drives a short hook into his body and throws him: at 00:07.0 he crashes onto the pavement at her feet. Thug B in the gray bomber looms at the right edge of frame.

SHOT 3 (00:07.3-00:11.0) — Two at once. Wide, low lateral angle near ground level, the station canopy and glass facade behind, commuters watching in the distance; the camera tracks sideways with the fight. Thug A lies on the pavement on the left. Thug B lunges at her; she ducks, drives a knee into his stomach and a straight side kick into his torso; he doubles over and falls, curled up on the pavement (00:08.5). Thug C in the olive bomber charges in from the right; she pivots outside his grab, breaks it and hits him with a short elbow, her hair and coat whipping around (00:10.0); he staggers back but stays standing, crouched to charge again.

SHOT 4 (00:11.0-00:20.1) — The spinning kick and the hold. Low three-quarter frontal angle; the white taxi parked in the left background with the driver standing beside it, watching. Thug C lunges with a straight punch and grabs at her; she parries his wrist and snaps a high side kick into his chest (00:12.5-00:13.5), then whips into a spinning back kick. MUST SHOW: during the spin (00:13.5-00:14.5) her long black rose-embroidered coat fans out wide like a cape across the frame, a brief slow-motion beat at contact, then back to real time. Thug C flies backward, slams onto the pavement (00:15.0) and rolls onto his back. The camera dollies back slowly and settles into a locked wide frame (00:16.0-00:20.1): the heroine stands center-left facing the camera, feet apart, hands relaxed at her sides, coat settling, with a small sideways glance and a barely visible smirk; the driver stands safely beside the white taxi behind her on the left; all three thugs lie still on the pavement on the right; commuters stand frozen in the background. No victory pose.

SOUND: Natural Japanese dialogue, no music. Shot 1: station ambience, idling taxi engines, footsteps; driver, struggling: "離してください！"; Thug A: "黙れ！"; one sharp slap; commuters gasp. Shot 2: heroine, calm and low: "女に手を上げるな。"; whoosh of the punch, a heavy body-hook thud, coat fabric swishing, a body slamming onto stone. Shot 3: knee and kick impacts, grunts, boot heels scraping the paving. Shot 4: the slap of the parry, a deep fabric whoosh of the spin, a heavy kick impact, a body hitting the pavement, then quiet station ambience; driver, softly: "ありがとうございます。"

NEGATIVE: blood, gore, a fourth attacker, extra fallen people, swapped positions, on-screen text, subtitles, logos, watermarks.
prompt_short: 20s 16:9 photoreal action at an overcast Japanese station taxi rank. A pale woman with long ash-blonde hair in a black rose-embroidered duster coat steps from a taxi, sees 3 thugs slap a female driver and drops all 3 with a throw, knee and spinning kick. No music.
